description: Usinas de Triagem e Compostagem is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Camada de pontos da localização das cinco usinas de triagem e compostagem classificadas como adequadas no ICMS-Ecológico 2010: Cantagalo, Miracema, Paty do Alferes, São José de Ubá e São Sebastião do Alto.Dado elaborado em Julho de 2010, pelo projeto O Estado do Ambiente: Indicadores ambientais do Rio de Janeiro. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Downloadable Data, ESTADO DO AMBIENTE, SANEAMENTO, INEA, RIO DE JANEIRO. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
